spot.html_text: This view of set theory gave rise to the Theory of Types. In the Theory of Types (as simplified successively by Ramsey, Carnap, Gödel and Quine) the bottom type is a collection of atoms. Atoms are non-sets (dormice, teapots, anything you please) with no internal structure visible to the set theory.
